## VaultV1Reallocation interface

> Warning: This API is now obsolete.
>
> Vault V1 shared-liquidity support will be removed in the next major. Use [VaultV2BlueReallocation](./morpho-sdk.vaultv2bluereallocation.md)<!-- -->.
>

A computed reallocation for a single vault.

Maps 1:1 to a `PublicAllocator.reallocateTo()` call. Withdraws from source markets and supplies to the target market.

```typescript
export interface VaultV1Reallocation
```
